profile.address: Campus Universitario de Espinardo, Murcia, Spain
profile.reading: This is the KIO Networks data center at the University Campus in Espinardo, Murcia, Spain, the operators first Spanish facility. The site occupies 172 square meters of constructed area with 193 kilowatts of power capacity, backed by two 600 kVA redundant UPS units and dual 1,200 kilowatt diesel generators offering four days of autonomy, built on seismic resistant pedestals with 2N architecture for both electrical and cooling systems. KIO Networks Espana began as a joint venture between Mexican operator KIO Networks and Spanish retail conglomerate El Corte Ingles, which held 50 percent ownership before completing a full buyout of the remaining stake, a transaction registered with Spains Commercial Registry by November 27, 2024, dissolving the prior board and installing new leadership including Javier Felipe Egea Caballero, El Corte Ingles director of strategy, corporate development, and participations. The Murcia facility was reportedly the first data center in Spain to enter the CEEDA energy efficiency certification process. El Corte Ingles has used the acquisition to expand into data center management services for outside clients, alongside a second, larger KIO facility under development in Valencia. KIO Networks, the Mexican parent brand behind the original 50 percent stake in this Spanish joint venture, was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Mexico City, describing itself as a leading provider of carrier neutral digital infrastructure and data center services across Mexico and other Latin American markets, with facilities including two in Queretaro, Mexico rated around 18 to 19 megawatts each. El Corte Ingles, founded June 28, 1940 in Madrid, is described as the largest department store group in Europe and the third largest in the world, spanning department stores, the Hipercor hypermarket chain, Supercor and Opencor convenience formats, Sfera fashion retail, Bricor home improvement, travel agency services, financial services and insurance, and IT services, an unusually diversified retail base for a company now also directly operating enterprise data center infrastructure through this Murcia facility and its newer Valencia site.
